# Lumen Advisory

> Lumen Advisory is an independent trustee company based in Liechtenstein, partnering with internationally minded entrepreneurs, founders and families — often self-made, often operating across multiple jurisdictions — who need clarity before they need a product.

## About

Lumen Advisory combines fiduciary expertise with legal and notarial experience to build structures that fit: asset protection, succession planning, relocation and long-term family governance.

The firm has offices in Schaan (Liechtenstein), Vienna (Austria), and Kraków (Poland), working primarily with clients across Central and Eastern Europe.

Lumen Advisory is not a bank and does not manage investments. It manages the legal architecture around assets — foundations, trusts, and companies — on behalf of its clients.

## FAQ

**What does an independent trustee company do?**
A trustee company manages the legal structures that hold and protect assets — foundations, trusts, and companies. It handles governance, administration, and continuity on behalf of clients. Unlike a private bank or wealth manager, it does not invest money. It builds and maintains the architecture around it.

**Why Liechtenstein?**
Liechtenstein has one of the oldest and most respected legal frameworks for foundations and trusts in the world — its foundation law dates to 1926. It sits within the European Economic Area, offers strong regulatory oversight, and maintains a reputation for legal stability and discretion.

**Who are Lumen Advisory's typical clients?**
Self-made entrepreneurs, founders and families with assets, business interests or family members across multiple countries — often relocating, restructuring, or planning for the next generation.
